response.justification: Strong individual-contributor profile with 15+ years of software development and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth (built a D test runner and assertion library, Selenium curriculum, CI/CD and GitLab/Docker infrastructure, MCP code generators). However, the resume shows no evidence of the core requirement for this role: formal people management. There are no manager or team-lead titles, no mention of direct reports, performance reviews, one-on-ones, hiring, or leading organizational change. Staff/Senior Engineer and open-source founder roles suggest technical leadership and mentoring, but that is inferred rather than demonstrated. Mobile-platform exposure is real but dated and shallow (iOS/tvOS takeover in 2015-2016, device orchestration tooling). Worth a screening call to probe for unlisted leadership scope, but as written the candidate does not meet the minimum management bar.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure experience (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, DevOps)
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop and embedded; credible system design and low-latency engineering background
Demonstrated knowledge sharing: workshops, courses, conference talks, and open-source project founder
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (misses the 2-year minimum)
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform experience is limited and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
